FN-U9H8BXD-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 303
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Russell Bedsole
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 01/30/2026
House Bill 303 as introduced creates the Cryptocurrency Kiosk Fraud Prevention Act and could
increase receipts to the Alabama Securities Commission Fund by $1,000 per day from penalties
assessed by the Alabama Securities Commission for violations provided by this bill.
